subject: comparing instrument reliability of an adaptive test for different groups

messages.author: 8a9dc1e734eac985
messages.subject: comparing instrument reliability of an adaptive test for different groups
parts:
More than 10k people filled out an online adaptive ability test.
The test results are scored with mirt.
I would like to see if the reliability of the instrument was the same for a small subgroup than for others with similar ability level.
The average ability of this group is much higher than for the rest of my test-takers.
Could you recommend a test for this?

Many thx.
B.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: comparing instrument reliability of an adaptive test for different groups
parts:
Have you looked into the multipleGroup() function? It sounds like what you are trying to look for is some type of differential item/bundle/test functioning (see also the DRF() function). 

Phil
